scope: CPU calibration tooling and tests ready; production calibration artifact not fitted

commits.step: Trace verified gain, comparator, horizon and CRN seed contracts
Implement isotonic calibration, strict record ingestion, metrics, SVG, CLI and 40 CPU tests

receipt_commit: The commit adding this file; resolve with git log -1 -- T1C_READY.json

source_contract.wm_gain: sumo_verify.verify stores predicted_saving[i] from candidate saving_vs_policy (legacy fallback: saving_vs_mappo)
source_contract.comparator_proof: Require cand<i>.spec.json, verify branch_sha256 and plan identity against receipt, require explicit saving_vs_policy equal to predicted_saving[i]; skip missing own-policy scores rather than mix comparators
source_contract.sumo_gain: J_policy_veh_s - J_candidates_veh_s[i], checked against the graded branch's J_veh_s
source_contract.target: SUMO gain > 0; ties and losses are non-wins
source_contract.selection: All graded candidates from accepted AND rejected WM decisions, not chosen_plan/grade_veh_s or admitted-only examples; failed/ungraded branches not imputed; random proposer excluded
source_contract.wm_score_origin: mppi_runtime.label_list8_search / mppi_search final scoring: WM mean policy cost minus WM mean candidate cost
source_contract.probability_semantics: Existing verified formats contain mean gains, not raw WM P(better). Isotonic PAVA fits WM mean own-policy gain (veh-s) -> empirical P(SUMO gain > 0). p_best is not used as P(better).
source_contract.all8_reader: Follow identity-linked first_seed, seed2 and optional extra group receipts; validate confirmation_sha256 and linked receipt_sha256. Do not read per_seed_v1 admitted-only outcomes, extended/solo results, tapes or snapshots.
source_contract.seed_group: episode.world.seed; replay_bank.replicate changes post-t0 RNG only, so all CRN replicas/candidates/updates/arms of a world stay together
code_references: tools/coopmwm/verify_perseed.py: confirm_all8 receipt links and build_example

api.load_verified_records(paths, dev_seeds): Explicit verified/all8 JSON file paths and explicit development seed allowlist -> (list[Example], provenance including skipped counts and source hashes). Requires candidate branch specs next to each verification root. No directory scanning.
api.split_by_seed(examples, dev_seeds, valid: Deterministic original-world split; at least two worlds; no candidate-level or CRN-level leakage
api.fit_calibration(examples, dev_seeds, val: Fit only fit partition; require fit wins and non-wins. Return model, independent dev-world validation, fit metrics, seeds, dataset digest, window provenance and limitations.
api.Calibrator.predict_probability(wm_gain_v: Scalar calibrated P(realised gain > 0); input MUST be WM mean own-policy gain in veh-s, not an uncalibrated probability. PAVA monotone step function, out-of-domain scores clamp to boundary blocks.
api.Calibrator.to_dict / Calibrator.from_dic: JSON model serialization; validate method, input score, monotonicity, probability range and finite values
api.load_calibrator(path): Load CLI artifact after artifact hash/schema and disjoint non-eval fit/validation seed checks; return Calibrator
api.reliability(probabilities, labels, n_bin: Equal-width bins with count, mean_probability, observed_frequency; weighted ECE, MCE and Brier score; empty bins represented explicitly
api.reliability_svg(metrics): Standalone SVG reliability diagram, including identity line and per-bin count tooltips

cli.required: --records <explicit verified/all8 JSON paths...> --dev-seeds <allowed dev world seeds...> --output <new model JSON> --reliability-svg <new diagram SVG>
cli.outputs: Model JSON with hash, fit/validation metrics, seed split, source receipt hashes, dataset hash, recorded SUMO windows and limitations; validation reliability SVG. Existing output files refused; parent directories must already exist.
cli.online_use: cal = load_calibrator(artifact_path); p = cal.predict_probability(expected_gain_vs_policy_veh_s). T1B owns the registered p_star=0.8 decision gate and full-look-ahead scoring.

open_issues: No production model fitted: no explicit local dev receipt file list or seed allowlist was provided. Tests fit generated verified-format receipts with a fake CPU plant only.
Existing records provide WM mean gain, not raw WM P(better); online integration must pass mean own-policy gain to this API.

Existing SUMO verification windows can differ from WM horizons. Calibration targets the stored window and does not establish full-look-ahead probability validity. Recorded windows are preserved; online look-ahead must not be shortened.
Bank candidate selection differs from the entire online move distribution; independent dev-seed reliability is reported, not a deployment-performance claim.
All8 absolute links must point to already-local files with candidate specs. Missing/stale links or missing specs fail closed; there is no remote fetch or silent data substitution.
One pre-existing regression dependency failure: tools.leverprobe is missing.
